description: Snapshots of this project's existing MLX components, copied without changes; v2 data, tokenizer, orchestration and training loop are separate.
external_runtime_dependencies: ../.venv: pinned versions recorded in pyproject.toml and verified on workers at launch
../cluster/jaccl: existing pinned ring SSH configuration and production SSH wrapper
../scripts/check_ring_thunderbolt.py and imported network helpers: read-only preflight and wired transport
validation_scope: Offline generated-data tests and CPU miniature training/resume only. No live 150M training or distributed benchmark was performed.
